3049:**Your text is sent to the MCPJam team, outside your organization, and stored for 180 days.** It is kept in MCPJam's own data
base and never published. Summarize. Never paste secrets, tokens, or raw tool output. Requires a signed-in account (`cloud login`
or an `sk_` key).
3071:These commands manage your MCPJam platform session. `login` opens a browser for OAuth and stores the session locally; `logout
` removes it; `whoami` shows the account behind the current credentials.
3091:`--api-header` values are sent on MCPJam API requests and the login settings request only, never to the sign-in provider. MCP
Jam API requests never follow a redirect: a `3xx` answer exits `2` (`BACKEND_REDIRECT_REFUSED`).
